text:
Zoe: Heads-up: need a final decision on the MVP cut for tomorrow's stakeholder review. My proposal: cut Tenant Admin and Full Reporting to v1, keep SSO, onboarding, prompt-store, embeddings export (batch mode), and a single search/recall UI in MVP. We ship with safety flags and a rollback lane.

Miguel: Agree with moving Admin/Reporting to v1. Concern: pilots will want immediate visibility. Suggest a "counts-only" dashboard tile (searches, active users, exports) for MVP so pilots see traction. Low dev lift.

Priya: Ops note: embeddings export as nightly batch reduces infra risk. Estimate: batch export = 3d infra + 1d QA. Real-time export can be v1.

Sam: Latency tradeoff: without embcache we see tail spikes on >512 token sessions. Options: prefix-only cache (~2d work) or no cache + probes. I recommend prefix-only if we can hit the estimate. Otherwise we ship no-cache and enable probes.

Noor: UX: I'll wireframe counts tile + an "export pending" modal that explains batch timing. Also add a support blurb to the onboarding flow. ETA Wed AM.

Zoe: Proposed runtime guards and gates:
```
- mvp.latency-guard=true  # auto-throttle long requests
- mvp.cost-cap=750        # soft alert + ops freeze threshold
- mvp.embcache=false     # default, toggleable for canary
- pilot-acceptance: 3 pilot tenants onboarded + search P95 <= 400ms (soft)
```

Miguel: +1 to flags. Add QA steps to verify toggle doesn't require restart. I'll draft flag QA today.

Priya: I'll schedule synthetic probes every 10m for tail latency and a daily burnline report. Ops will watch alerts during pilot.

Sam: If prefix cache is green by EOD we can include it; otherwise we move it to post-pilot. I'll mark the autoshard work as deprioritized to free 3 engineer-days.

Zoe: Timeline: scope freeze Thu EOD; feature-freeze Mon 09:00; pilot start 2026-02-21; GA target 2026-03-09 with a 48h rollback window. If any pilot gate fails we pause GA and triage within 24h.

freeze-bot: Reminder: run `/freeze mvp-cut` before Mon 09:00 to lock PRs.

Noor: Action items: Zoe -> update cutboard + owners; Miguel -> flag QA doc; Priya -> probes + batch export plan; Sam -> prefix cache estimate and deprioritize autoshard; Noor -> UX + support blurb. Ping when done. :eyes:
